name: Cocoon of the Third Sister
description: A gigantic puffball-like fungal womb. Its pale surface swells and contracts as though breathing.

abilities.name: Life-Giving Spores
abilities.description: Cost: 1 HP. Mark 1 HP on the Cocoon and choose one Hag within Far range. That Hag may either clear 2 HP or clear 3 Stress.

abilities.name: Restorative Pulse
abilities.description: When either Hag marks 2 or more HP from a single attack, spend a Fear. That Hag clears 1 HP.

abilities.name: Poison Spore Burst
abilities.description: Cost: 1 Fear. All PCs within Close range must make an Instinct Reaction Roll (14). Failure: 1d8+3 magic damage and mark a Stress.

abilities.name: Death Burst
abilities.description: When the Cocoon marks its last HP, it violently ruptures. All creatures within Very Close range must make an Agility Reaction Roll (14). Failure: 1d8+3 magic damage. Then all healing and defensive features provided by the Cocoon immediately end.
